summary: Degree/weight check for (6,6) is correct: d=21, ordinary open input W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6}) of weight 26 and untwisted Tate type Q(-13), dual to W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} expected Q(8). The residual group is not formulated incorrectly. Harer's vcd is cited as [Har86] (Invent. Math. 84); the corpus operationally uses vanishing for k>4g-4+n (n>=1), giving vcd(M_{6,6})=26. Thus the ordinary open-input degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (6,6) and for every n>=2 RED-0001 residual pair; (8,0) and (8,1) sit one below. No proved Hodge-structure theorem discharges W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6}): top-degree vcd vanishing only kills degrees >26; CKgP/Prop 4.5 stop at n<=5 in genus 6; compactified even cohomology is proved pure Tate only through degree 14, with 16/18/20 still open predictions as of the May 2026 survey. Point counts, Euler characteristics, semisimplifications, and Chenevier-Lannes/Taut-20 predictions were not treated as discharges.
unresolved: No primary-text extract of Harer's Invent. Math. 84 theorem statement is in the supplied corpus (only secondary citations).
No theorem computes or forces Tate type of W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6}).

Extending CKgP in genus 6 from n<=5 to n=6 (or otherwise controlling the open pure-weight top-degree piece) remains open and would be needed to discharge this residual by the low-homology induction method.
Hard Lefschetz / tautological generation results for complementary degrees on Mbar do not transfer to a discharge of the open pure-weight residual at degree 26.
